paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in Ammon suante kumpipa asi a, atapa Hanun in amun ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: David In Ammonte Leh Siriate Azou / (1 Kro 19.1-19)

paite: David in, "Apa'n hon na hehpih bang in ke'n leng Nahash tapa Hanun ka hehpih sam ding," achi hi. Huchi in David in apa tungtang thu a lungmuan ding in amah mite asawl a, huchi in David mite Ammon suante gam ava tung uhi.

Himahleh Ammon suante makaite'n atoupa uh Hanun kiang ah, "David in na pa azahtak ziak a na kiang a lungmuanmi hon sawl hi in na um a hia? David in na mite khuate ahong hihsiatna dia zongkhe ding leh enkhe dia hon sawl ahi kei a hia?" achi uhi.
Huchi in Hanun in David mite aman a, akhamul langkhat uh ametsak a, apuansilhte uh alaitak ah ataw uh phazou lel in atansak a, asawlkheta hi.
David ahilhtak un, amau dawn ding mi asawl hi; amau lah azum mahmah ngal ua. Kumpipa'n, "Na khamul uh asau nawn ma in Jeriko ah om tadih unla, huai nung in hong paikik un," achi hi.

Ammon suante'n David huat lam ana hihta uh, chih atheih un, Ammon suante'n Beth-rehob a Siriate leh Zobah a Siriate sepaih singnih leh kumpipa Maka mi sangkhat, Tob mite singkhat-le-sangnih toh thukhak in aguai uhi.
David in huai azak in Joab leh sepaih hangsan tengteng asawl hi.
Ammon suante ahong kuan ua, kholutna kongkhak lam ah panmun akhoh uh. Zobah a mite leh Rehob a Siriate leh Tob leh Maakahte bel atuam in loubuk ah a-om uhi.
Huchi in amalam uh leh anunglam uah ahon sual ding uh chih Joab in atheih in, Israel mite lak a mihoih tata atelkhia a, Siria mite sual ding in panmun ana khoh hi.
Midang tengteng a-unaupa Abishai khut ah akoih vek a, Ammon suante sual ding in panmun akhoh hi.
"Siria mite ka zoh kei dingleh, nang na hon huh dia, Ammon suante na zoh kei dingleh ke'n ka hon huh ding hi.
Hangtak in om unla, i mite leh i Pathian khua hum in i kipasalsak ding uh. TOUPA'N hoih asak bangbang in hih hen," achi hi.
Huchi in Joab leh akiang a mite'n Siria mite sual ding in kidouna mun anaih ua; ama uah ataikek uhi.
Ammon suante'n Siria mite ataikek uh chih atheih un amau leng Abishai ma ah ataikek samta ua, khosung ah alut uhi. Joab in Ammon suante akiksan a, Jerusalem ah apaita hi.
Siria mite'n Israelte ma ah thah in a-om uh chih akitheih un akikaikhawm uhi.
Hadadezer in mi asawl a, Lui khen lam a Siria mite apikhia a, Hadadezer sepaih heutu Shobak in ma kai in lehlam ah ahong pai uhi.
Huai David ahilh ua, ama'n Israel mi tengteng asamkhawm a, Jordan lui kan in Helam ah apai uhi. David dou ding in Siria mite'n panmun khoh in ahong dou uhi.
Israelte ma ah Siria mite ataikek ua, David in Siria mi kangtalai zasagih tung a tuang leh sakol tungtuangmi singli athat a, asepaih heutu uh Shobak leng athat a, huai ah asita hi.

Huchi in Hadadezer sikha a om kumpipa tengteng in Israelte ma ah tamtak thah ahi uh chih atheih un, Israelte toh kilemna abawl ua, asikha un a-omta uh. Huchi in Siria mite'n Ammon suante apanpih ngam nawn kei uhi.
